subject: Next steps: vendor paperwork route & bank portal preference
messages:
From: Sally Myers <sally.myers@greenfieldhealth.org>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@greenfieldhealth.org>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call notes + paperwork preference (Greenfield)

Hi Olga — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and two decisions we need to capture on our side so we can start vendor setup: 

1) Paperwork path: we prefer to use our vendor portal (Greenfield Vendor Portal) for onboarding — we can push standard fields and collect banking info there. If Redwood supports portal-only activation, that would be ideal; otherwise we may need the vendor packet emailed to our ops team.

2) Payment routing: our finance team prefers PO + ACH for recurring spend, but for initial POC purchases they sometimes permit a company card. Please confirm whether Redwood accepts: PO (net 30) + ACH on file, and whether you can accept a one-time card charge to start.

Attachments: 
- Greenfield_W9.pdf (completed on our side for vendor records)
- GF_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (portal field mapping we asked you to confirm)

Next steps I proposed on the call: 
- Olga: confirm which packet/portal flow Redwood can support and whether we can do portal-first activation.
- Marcus: share the W-9 / payment instructions template you need (if different from GF form).
- Sally: I’ll open a vendor portal invite to the email you list below once you confirm the contact.

Thanks — Sally
Sally Myers
Senior Procurement Manager
Greenfield Health
procurement@greenfieldhealth.org

(Attachment: Greenfield_W9.pdf, GF_Onboarding_Form.xlsx)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sally Myers <sally.myers@greenfieldhealth.org>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call notes + paperwork preference (Greenfield)

Thanks Sally — great to meet you. Quick answers below and a suggested minimal mutual action plan.

Summary answers:
- Vendor portal: Redwood can support portal-first activation. We have a partner provisioning endpoint that accepts the standard GF_Onboarding_Form fields; we can accept an invite and auto-populate vendor metadata. If your portal requires manual upload only we can also email the vendor packet.
- Payment methods: we support PO (net 30) + ACH for recurring; one-time card charges are supported for initial purchases (card on file or single transaction). For PO-based invoicing we require a signed vendor packet + W-9 (or W-8 for foreign entities) and bank remit instructions for ACH.

Proposed immediate next steps (mutual action plan):
1) Greenfield: confirm the vendor email you’ll send the portal invite to (we recommend vendor@redwood.com).
2) Redwood (Marcus): I’ll attach our standard vendor packet and sample ACH remit template. Marcus — can you send the packet and a short checklist?
3) Greenfield: complete portal invite and indicate whether initial payment will be card or PO.
4) Redwood (Marissa): once packet + W-9 received we’ll expedite onboarding (target 3 business days).

I’ll also flag any required KYC fields that differ from your spreadsheet.

Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Commercial Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
(Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf - will follow in separate email)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sally Myers <sally.myers@greenfieldhealth.org>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood vendor packet + ACH remit template

Hi Sally — attaching the vendor packet and a short ACH remit template. The packet contains: W-9/W-8 selection, company legal name, tax ID, primary contact, banking details (routing, account), and remittance address.

Key notes: 
- If Greenfield will onboard via your vendor portal, you can skip the email upload; instead send the portal invitation to vendor@redwood.com and include the field mapping (we reviewed GF_Onboarding_Form.xlsx on the call).
- For PO invoicing, include the PO number on the invoice PDF and send invoices to ap@redwood.com. Our AP team pays net 30 via ACH.
- If you opt for a one-time card charge to expedite POC, Marissa will coordinate card-payment receipts.

Attachments in this email (stubs): 
- Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf (vendor packet with signature block)
- Redwood_ACH_Template.csv (example remit format)

Marissa — can you confirm we’ll accept portal invite to vendor@redwood.com and that we can reconcile GF fields with our partner endpoint?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

(Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf, Redwood_ACH_Template.csv)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor packet + ACH remit template

Sally — quick confirmation from our AP side: portal invite to vendor@redwood.com will work. When you send the invite please: 

- Select "Vendor: Enable ACH remittance" and attach your completed W-9 (or W-8).
- Indicate whether initial purchase will be card or PO in the portal notes field (this triggers different onboarding queues).

If you choose PO: AP needs the signed vendor packet and the PO number included on the invoice. If card: Marissa will send a secure payment link and a receipt for reconciliation.

We’ll aim to finish internal intake within 72 hours of receiving the completed packet and W-9.

Best — looking forward to getting you live,
Marissa Cole
Commercial Finance Lead, Redwood Inference
